title: Ideas must be more than a summary of their source
description: Ryan 11-02. Fable review: 13 of 13 single-item ideas restate the source because the prompt asks for it and the writer gets nothing else. Decisions: an accept reason clears the bar, except that a Reference whose page could not be read also needs a human comment or a real related Reference; adversarial model check waits for the replay; a pack with titles only is skipped; editors reject with a reason rather than delete; build and replay now. Small sites propose fewer ideas, no relaxed bar. An empty run raises a curation suggestion.
